user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Web content for ChatGPT search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited when users ask questions or trigger actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for generative AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in your robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites in response to individual questions asked by Claude users.
user_agents.scope: Websites retrieved during user-initiated requests and user-directed web searches.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-User in your robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in your robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls to build Google's search indexes and perform product-specific crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images, Discover, and image-based Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls videos for video-related Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content specifically for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content to support all surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Runs Search testing tools including Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler used by product teams for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content fetched for internal research and development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs across sites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs across sites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs site-owner requested crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawl requests requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and Search grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet automatically or per request.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for search features like Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models powering generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Determines usage of data crawled by Applebot; does not crawl webpages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content of an app or website shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information about shared links, including title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for use cases improving advertising and business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow directive in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models or improves products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to train foundation AI models and index content for products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow directive in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks for users upon request.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for Bing search indexing and Copilot experiences.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible websites across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow bingbot in robots.txt or use noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews for Bing search and Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Pages requested for preview generation across Bing services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Microsoft-Inspection-Tool
user_agents.purpose: Inspects URLs and verifies configuration for Bing Webmaster Tools.
user_agents.scope: Pages tested on demand by site owners in Webmaster Tools.
user_agents.opt_out: Initiated on demand by verified site owners.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to provide accurate customer information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, rel=nofollow, or robots meta tags like noarchive.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences across Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not train generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information on user behalf to answer queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live web fetching; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler building open datasets for research and analysis
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt Disallow rule or the opt-out registry
